for (dept_name in dept_abbr) {
  print(dept_name)
  cat(rep("-", 5), collapse = ""); cat("\n")

  dept_url = paste0(
    "https://bulletin.miamioh.edu/courses-instruction/", dept_name, "/")

  webpage = rvest::read_html(dept_url)

  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("strong") |> rvest::html_text2() -> titles
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("#sc_sccoursedescs > div > p.courseblockdesc") |> rvest::html_text2() -> descs

  n = min(length(titles), length(descs))
  df = data.frame(title = titles[1:n], desc = descs[1:n])
  df$title[1] |> print()

  courses_df = rbind(courses_df, df)
}
